target: Replace distributed Windows installation behavior with one hash-bound, resumable, cross-version transaction without changing archive, summary, capture, cloud, or environment semantics.
invariants: Raw archives and active archive pointers are never rewritten by installer governance.
Only one installer transaction controller may mutate installation state.
A released installer is byte-identical to the CI artifact installed successfully on the target device.
A second failed integrated remediation requires replanning instead of another patch.
prohibited_changes: Modify Summary V2 or semantic maintenance behavior.
Publish or install a candidate before its ordered gates complete.
